snippet.title: [Revisited Online] Gotenks (Sloth) VS Gogeta (AL)
snippet.description:
A segment of a play session AL and I had.  He doesn't get the chance to play much so I'm grateful he was able to find some time after we tested his new connection!

We did not use the 100 Power level save.

__________________________________________________________
Intro 00:00
Match 1 00:05
Match 2 3:32
Match 3 5:58
Match 4 10:50
Match 5 13:39
Match 6 16:34
Socializing 21:25
Match 7 21:46
Match 8 24:45
Match 9 28:00
Outro 31:19

Outro song
Win32 - https://soundcloud.com/win32/manifesto-1
__________________________________________________________
SBAR: R (Shin Budokai Another Road Revisited) is a competitive mod for Shin Budokai Another Road, previously known as Double Npact.  It's not perfect but it sure is fun to play with a high skill ceiling (It can be very complex if you strive to improve).

__________________________________________________________
You can find some play sessions on the Sho Rose channel

Last recorded set - https://youtu.be/4Tc1jtDeSs0?si=HxnJN6Un_Wpl0P4w

https://www.youtube.com/c/ShoRos%C3%A9
